method.name: MILP with Highspy direct formulation
steps: Define integer variables A (advertising spend >= 0) and P (promotion spend >= 0)
C1: 4*A + 5*P >= 100  (effectiveness constraint: each $1 gives 4/5 impact points)
C2: A - P <= 50        (balance: advertising cannot exceed promotion by more than $50)
Minimize A + P (total spending) using HiGHS solver at zero MIP gap
